subject: Security exhibit: staging access request, SOC 2 transfer, and evidence cadence
messages:
From: Jane Morris <jane.morris@luminahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@luminahealth.com
Date: Fri, 10 Feb 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Security exhibit items — SOC 2 report transfer & pen test window

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we move towards finalizing the Order Form I need to confirm a few items for our InfoSec review around the security exhibit:

- Can you provide the latest SOC 2 summary report and the expected cadence for evidence requests?
- We need pen-test language that clarifies scope and an initial proposed window (we prefer a mid-March window).
- Lumina requests temporary staging access for validated test accounts and a short checklist for what we can/cannot access.

If possible, can you share the SOC 2 summary and a draft pen-test scope by end of day Tuesday so our security team can review ahead of next week’s procurement call?

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if that helps.

Best,
Jane Morris
Director, Security Programs
Lumina Health

[Attachment: lumina_security_questionnaire.xlsx (stub)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Morris <jane.morris@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Feb 2028 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit items — SOC 2 report transfer & pen test window

Jane —

Thanks for the clear list. We can do the following:

1) SOC 2 summary: attaching our 2027 SOC 2 summary PDF (redwood internal doc, redacted). We'll also provide a short bridge letter outlining changes since the last report.

2) Pen test scope: attached is a proposed scope spreadsheet. High level: external network and platform-level app testing against non-prod/staging only; no production exploitation; agreed blast-radius and rollback plan. We propose the window Mar 18–22. If that doesn't work for Lumina, propose alternatives.

3) Staging access checklist: attached draft checklist for test accounts and allowed artifacts. We'll require a signed mutual action plan and a short NDA addendum for staging credentials.

Action items for us: Karthik, can you validate the proposed wording for the MSA security exhibit (pen-test & audit rights) to ensure it aligns with our standard Order Form language? Marcus — can you confirm the limited IAM roles we'll provide for Lumina testers and whether we need a hardened snapshot?

Jane — once they look okay, we can share a package with the formal redlines for the Order Form and an evidence cadence proposal.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2027.pdf (stub); proposed_pen_test_scope.xlsx (stub); staging-access-checklist.docx (stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Feb 2028 10:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit items — SOC 2 report transfer & pen test window

Kimberly / Marcus —

I reviewed the proposed pen-test scope and the draft Order Form language. A few notes from legal/compliance:

- Audit rights: we should keep the standard mutually-limited audit clause (reasonable frequency, scoped to customer data and configuration); do not commit to live production access.
- SOC 2 transfer: fine to provide the summary and bridge letter; for the full report we ask Lumina to execute an NDA/TOE if they require the SOC 2 auditor's report.
- Pen testing: approve Mar 18–22 only if Lumina signs the staging access addendum and the mutual action plan. Add an explicit kill-switch contact for immediate remediation.
- Evidence cadence: propose a weekly 2-week window where Lumina submits a targeted evidence list; Redwood commits to a 3-business-day turnaround on straightforward evidence requests (logs, configuration screenshots) and will schedule deeper artifacts on a mutually agreed timeline.

Laura — can you prepare the short addendum language for the staging credentials and the kill-switch contact block? I'll draft the Order Form redline for the MSA security exhibit and circulate by EOD.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Morris <jane.morris@luminahealth.com>, security@luminahealth.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Feb 2028 17:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit items — SOC 2 report transfer & pen test window

Jane —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Next steps and asks below:

- We've attached the SOC 2 summary and the draft pen-test scope and staging checklist for your security team's review. (See attachments.)
- Legal will circulate a redline of the MSA security exhibit today; that will include: limited audit rights language, staging access addendum, and the mutual action plan.
- Proposed pen-test window: Mar 18–22. Please confirm by Thu 2/17 so we can lock resource availability.
- Evidence cadence proposal: Redwood proposes a two-tier cadence — (a) Quick evidence requests (logs, simple configs) with 3 business day SLA; (b) Deep artifact requests scheduled within 10 business days with a named owner and scheduled delivery. If Lumina has a pre-approved list of routine artifacts, we can automate weekly exports for those items.

If you'd like a 30-minute touchpoint to walk through the redlines and access controls this week, I can coordinate.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this piece so procurement can finalize the Order Form.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2027.pdf (stub); proposed_pen_test_scope.xlsx (stub); staging-access-checklist.docx (stub)
